title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Terms: Fit of the Vehicle to the Space Class and Changes to Vehicle Details
content:
### Clause 1 — Fit of the vehicle (no longer in force)

The former clause read: the vehicle on file must fit the space class — its type must be among the vehicle types permitted for the class and its overall length, including trailer tongue and outboard motor, must not exceed the class's maximum vehicle length — on the tenant's statement of the vehicle's type and length. **This clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for putting a vehicle on file.

### Clause 2 — A vehicle that does not fit

A vehicle that does not fit is not reserved or placed on file under the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement; the tenant is offered a space class that fits.

### Clause 3 — When vehicle details may change

Vehicle details are changed only while the agreement is in active status or under a compliance termination notice, as the agreement record shows. A renewed registration or insurance for the same vehicle is a details update: it carries no fee and does not count as a vehicle swap.

### Clause 4 — Putting a different vehicle on file

The opening words of this clause, that a different vehicle may be put on file only on an agreement in active status, are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis for changing the vehicle on file.

The rest of the clause stands: a different vehicle is put on file at most the swap allowance of the space class times in a rolling 365-day window. The window is the 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, that date included, and the count is the number of vehicle swap fees posted on the agreement with a posting date inside it.

The further words of this clause, that each swap posts the vehicle swap fee of the class, are also **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis for the vehicle swap fee.

### Points of judgement

| Agreement standing | Renewed registration or insurance for the same vehicle |
|---|---|
| Active | May be recorded; no fee; not counted as a swap |
| Under a compliance termination notice | May be recorded; no fee; not counted as a swap |
| Any other standing | Vehicle details are not changed |

Hypothetical count: with an allowance of 2, an agreement whose ledger shows vehicle swap fees posted 200 days and 40 days before the handling date has used 2 swaps in the window; a swap fee posted 366 days before would fall outside it.

superseded_clauses: The vehicle on file must fit the space class: its type must be in allowed_vehicle_types and its overall length, including trailer tongue and outboard motor, must not exceed max_vehicle_length_ft.
A different vehicle may be put on file only on an agreement in active status
